title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

errors: The construction implicitly requires i_{L₀,Z}(l) to act on Ĝ⁺ as int(l), so that the antidiagonal map is a homomorphism with normal image. It also requires L₀^♮→Z to be injective, so that Ĝ⁺ injects into G_{ρ,σ}. Both are asserted, not checked, on this page.
Composition order is inconsistent in (33): χ_G = χ_γ∘δ_G and ε_{2G} = ε_{2γ}δ_G, but ε_{3G} is written δ_G ε_{3γ}. This is a notational slip.

Diagram (31) contains a struck-out arrow and an erased label. The previous page carries a marginal correction ('c'est mauvais — on peut pas exiger d)'): condition (4)d does not force a trivial action on Ĝ⁺/Ĝ^♮. This affects what Z_{ρ,σ} and hence γ really are.
(34) is only sketched ('etc. ....'), and the margin note says the same must be done for G^♮.

ideas.what: Quotienting the semidirect product Z⋉Ĝ by the antidiagonal image of the inner subgroup, to obtain an extension of the outer group γ by Ĝ⁺ (pushout of 1→L→Z→γ→1 along L→Ĝ)
ideas.modern_name: Pushout of group extensions / extension associated to an outer action (Schreier–Eilenberg–MacLane theory)
ideas.where_published: Standard nonabelian-extension technique; Grothendieck uses the same device on p.577 of these notes

ideas.what: Pulling back characters (cyclotomic χ, sign characters ε₂, ε₃) from the outer group to the extension and taking kernel subgroups G', G'', G''', G°, G⁺
ideas.modern_name: Cyclotomic and orientation characters on GT-type groups; index-2/4 subgroups
ideas.usually_credited_to: Drinfeld / Ihara (cyclotomic character on GT); general practice

ideas.what: Building an automorphism group of the profinite modular-type group Ĝ⁺ that preserves the conjugacy classes of ρ, σ (up to twisting by complex conjugation τ) and of ε₀ up to the cyclotomic power, i.e. a GT-like group for the (2,3,∞) setting
ideas.modern_name: GT-type groups acting on the profinite modular group / profinite Teichmüller modular groups
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme sketches the Teichmüller tower programme; this specific construction is not published

deep.surprise_reason: The page is mostly bookkeeping: a standard pushout of extensions plus the definition of characters and kernel subgroups. It belongs to Grothendieck's unpublished GT-like analysis of automorphisms of the profinite modular-type group, with sign characters ε₂, ε₃ and the orientation element τ. That approach parallels later work by Lochak–Schneps and Nakamura et al.; nothing on this page itself appears to be a new result.
transcription_corrections: (29) is G_{ρ,σ} := SoG_{ρ,σ}/Im L₀^♮. The 'Z_{ρ,σ}·Ĝ⁺' written under SoG is an annotation (SoG = Z·Ĝ⁺), not a denominator. The right-hand part reads '⊃ G^♮_{ρ,σ} = SoG^♮_{ρ,σ}/Im L₀^♮'.
In (32) the first vertical arrow is L₀^♮ → Ĝ^♮ and the bottom row is 1→Ĝ⁺→G_{ρ,σ}→γ_{ρ,σ}→1. The rows are linked by vertical inclusions Ĝ^♮⊂Ĝ⁺ and G^♮⊂G, with equalities on γ.
(35) reads 'Si τ_G ∈ G^♮_{ρ,σ} ⊂ G_{ρ,σ}, τ_γ ∈ γ_{ρ,σ}', continuing on the next page with 'désignons les images de τ_Z (26)'.
The opening line reads approximately 'd'image invariante, on peut prendre le quotient et poser' (likely reading).
